verdict.rationale: Runway's documentation has only fragments relevant to this story. The pricing page states a parallel-generation cap (20 videos & images) for app plans. The developer docs mention self-serve usage tiers with an exception request for higher usage, and an async task model where you poll a task ID until it reaches SUCCEEDED or FAILED. Missing for 10: documented API concurrency limits per tier, queue ordering and wait behavior (e.g. a PENDING/throttled state), rate-limit error handling and retry guidance, batch-submission semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline

citations.quote: To request higher usage than the self-serve tiers, you can submit an exception request on the usage page of your developer portal.
send a request to receive a task id, then poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until the task reaches `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED`
